question_1_geometry.finding: No public CAD model, lines plan, dimensioned hull drawing, mass-distribution drawing, or thruster-coordinate drawing was found in the checked manufacturer material, the public FIU-MoRA-Lab repository, or locally supplied files.

sources_checked.result: Confirms product identity but gates the manufacturer PDF behind a form; no CAD or dimensioned mechanical drawing is exposed.

sources_checked.source: SeaRobotics SR-Surveyor M1.8 manufacturer specification sheet (public mirror)
sources_checked.result: Confirms overall dimensions, draft, weight, twin 1 kW pocket thrusters, differential steering, endurance, battery and sensor options; provides no hull sections, mass distribution, thruster coordinates, bollard-pull curve or actuator time constant.

Public control and sensor integration repository. Root tree contains requirements, surveyor_lib, tests and project metadata; no mechanical/CAD asset is advertised. The linked full automation repository was not publicly readable during this audit.
Only surveyor_vehicle_replacement.md was present; no STEP, IGES, DWG, DXF, CAD or additional Surveyor document was found.

question_1_geometry.answer: A defensible model cannot currently be derived from actual hull geometry. Unless FIU or SeaRobotics supplies CAD/drawings and loaded mass-property information, Step 1 must use a clearly labeled approximation constrained by the published envelope, draft and mass; photo inference alone cannot establish an actual inertia tensor or thruster coordinates.
required_private_inputs_to_avoid_approxi: loaded configuration and center of gravity
port/starboard thruster mounting coordinates and axes
forward/reverse bollard-pull versus integer command and battery voltage
deadband, lag/time constant and slew-rate measurements

question_2_replacement_scope.finding: The repository contains three distinct identities that must not be conflated: the 1000 kg synthetic bcod_usv geometry bootstrap, the 55 kg MSS-derived vehicle-a-otter, and an existing 52.3 kg searobotics-surveyor-m1.8 integration-only preset.

identity_inventory.role: Synthetic 4.8 m x 2.4 m, 1000 kg geometry bootstrap used by Gazebo generation and recent Gate 7 scaffolding.
MSS-derived 2.0 m, 55 kg validated planar reference used broadly by benchmarks, deterministic tests, task calibration, policy evaluation, tensor parity and release fixtures.
Existing integration-only preset with manufacturer envelope/mass but assumed inertia, thruster coordinates, damping and 1 N-per-command projection.

question_2_replacement_scope.common_task_identity_risk: The calibration scripts name vehicle-a-otter, while the recent external Gazebo Gate 7 model uses bcod_usv. Treating either name as an interchangeable 'Vehicle A' is already ambiguous and must be corrected before recalibration.
question_2_replacement_scope.answer: Do not globally replace or delete either existing vehicle. Retain vehicle-a-otter as the named MSS validation/reference vehicle and retain bcod_usv only as a named historical synthetic fixture. Promote searobotics-surveyor-m1.8 to the common-task campaign vehicle through an explicit task/config migration. Historical bootstrap/Otter artifacts must remain immutable and vehicle-labeled.

recommended_step_1_scope.decision_needed: Approve a Surveyor common-task migration while retaining Otter and bcod_usv as separately named non-campaign/historical vehicles.
recommended_step_1_scope.geometry_path: First request private FIU/vendor CAD and mass-property data. If unavailable, approve a documented approximate hull model; it must not be described as actual geometry or actual inertia.
recommended_step_1_scope.single_source_of_truth_target: A new versioned Surveyor vehicle artifact consumed by Node, Gazebo and VRX without downstream re-derivation.
recommended_step_1_scope.prohibited_shortcut: The checked-in assumed inertia [3.8, 14.7, 16.3] kg m^2, +/-0.35 m thruster coordinates, damping values and 1 N-per-command mapping are integration placeholders and are not acceptable as measured Surveyor parameters.

halt.reason: Step 0 complete. The adopted instructions require confirmation before Step 1, and the absence of public actual geometry creates a material choice between obtaining private data and authorizing a documented approximation.
